description_en: Resets instances to their initial state at the time of creation
description_zh: 初始化实例到创建时的初始状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone reset-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id cp-xxxxxx --image-id cpm-xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetInstances

parameters.description_en: The list of cloud phone instance IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.
parameters.description_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，N取值范围1-100
parameters.help_en: The list of cloud phone instance IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，N取值范围1-100
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The cloud phone image ID. If this parameter is not specified, the instance is reset by using its current image.
parameters.description_zh: 云手机镜像ID，若不指定，则按当前实例的镜像进行重置。
parameters.help_en: The cloud phone image ID. If this parameter is not specified, the instance is reset by using its current image
parameters.help_zh: 云手机镜像ID，若不指定，则按当前实例的镜像进行重置
parameters.name: image_id
